_about: Hand-picked pictures for the home page (designer, 16 Nov 2026). Each entry is the YouTube ID of a set in the catalogue. Order = preference: the page takes the first ones it finds in the database and fills any gap from the most watched sets. 'seen: false' means the thumbnail could not be viewed when it was picked (chosen from title, place and channel) and still needs the owner's eye.
